'''Gerik''' was a person who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Gerik was the proprietor of [[The Store]], a general store that was located in the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]]. Gerik did a lot of trading with offworlders.<ref name="Child of Light">"[[Child of Light]]"</ref>
